boxes.operational_outcome: False stop: item hidden under packing caught as missing item
Safe stop: absent item with covered void caught as missing item

notes: Hard boxes are strictly kept out of main table FP/FN counts.
UNIT-0043 (item hidden, box correctly packed) produced a false stop (STOP_AND_FIX).
UNIT-0049 (blurry photo) produced an unverified SEAL prior to the blur gate; caught as UNCERTAIN with the blur gate.
UNIT-0081 (item absent, packing covering space) produced a safe stop (STOP_AND_FIX).

wrong_boxes.explanation: Required item hidden under packing material; model reported missing (false stop).
Required item physically absent with void covered; model caught absent item as missing (safe stop).

right_verdict_wrong_reason.note: Right verdict, wrong reason: Model identified decoy sunscreen in place of sanitizer, producing false fails on all_items_present and nothing_extra alongside valid fail on quantities_correct (3 soaps packed vs 2 expected).

clean_boxes_summary.notes: Of the 7 dev boxes that were actually packed correctly (5 clear + UNIT-0043 + UNIT-0049): 5 were sealed, 1 was a false stop (UNIT-0043), 1 went to manual check (UNIT-0049).
